name: dl_forecasts
description: LONG format forecasts (one row per node x origin time x horizon x target x model). Written by Stage02_DL/03_dl_engineer.py to Stage02_DL/predictions/dl_forecasts.csv. Baselines (persistence, seasonal_naive, xgb_lag) go in the same file with their own model_name so Evaluation can compute skill scores.

columns.name: origin_ts
columns.note: The last hour the model was allowed to see.

columns.name: y_lo
columns.note: Lower bound of the prediction interval (e.g. 10th percentile).

columns.name: y_hi
columns.note: Upper bound of the prediction interval (e.g. 90th percentile).
